dedupe_keys.name: costal operating wind farms two datasets with concurrent scada lidar and turbulent fluxes

description: Passos, Júlio and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The collection covers Pedra do Sal and Beberibe from August 2013 to July 2014. Both farms have a 100 m instrumented mast and ten-minute turbine SCADA; Pedra do Sal also has additional sonic and profiling-lidar observations. Their installed fleets comprise twenty E-44 turbines and thirty-two E-48 turbines respectively. The source documents use in wind-profile, atmospheric-stability and farm-performance assessment. Measurement recovery varies and is not assumed complete from the summary. A historical industry-first harvest rejection deferred this energy resource to its own sector; that routing decision is preserved and explicitly superseded. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-sa-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
